CAPACITY_CONSTRAINTS.LABEL_FREQUENCIES: Each of the 3+3+3+40 physical labels has an integer frequency from 0 through 18 among outside tickets; cell frequency sums equal the corresponding type-coordinate totals.
CAPACITY_CONSTRAINTS.PAIRWISE_MAXIMUM_OVERLAP: For every outside-ticket pair, shared-label counts across the four cells sum to at most 3; good-ticket pairs therefore share at most 3 outside labels.
CAPACITY_CONSTRAINTS.TYPE_COUNT_CONSTRAINTS: For integer n_t>=0, sum_t n_t=18; the four coordinate totals equal their physical-label frequency sums, with at most 3*18 incidences in each 3-label anchor cell and 40*18 outside.

R3_PROOF.ANCHOR_COVER_IDENTITY: |union E_i| <= S1 - I(3) + sum_C net(C), where net(C)=J-I(s+a)-I(s+b)
R3_PROOF.FOREST_UNION_CORRECTION: For any forest on good residual events, union size is at most the sum of event sizes minus the sum of edge intersections.
R3_PROOF.LOCAL_RESIDUAL_IDENTITY: |E_C \ (E_A union E_B)| = N - I(s+a) - I(s+b) + J(3,s+a,s+b;s)
R3_PROOF.OUTSIDE_LABEL_PAIR_MASS: For m good tickets, f_l in 0..m, sum_l f_l=6m over 40 labels, Q=sum_l binom(f_l,2)=sum_{i<j} d_ij. Convexity gives the balanced-frequency minimum.
R3_PROOF.RESIDUAL_PAIR_IDENTITY: |R_C intersect R_D| >= I(d)-2*J(0,0,d); the omitted four-way anchor intersection is nonnegative.
R3_PROOF.TRADEOFF: At m<=6, at least 12 non-good tickets lose 442890 each. At m>=7, the exact frequency/forest census forces at least 1148000 residual outcomes of outside-overlap correction; the combined minimum over m=0..18 is 5314680 at m=6.
R3_PROOF.WEIGHTED_FOREST_CENSUS: With e_t=#pairs sharing at least t outside labels, e1>=e2>=e3 and e1+e2+e3=Q. A graph of forest rank r has at most binom(r+1,2) edges, so rank>=rho(e_t), where rho(e)=min{r:binom(r+1,2)>=e}. The maximum weighted forest has weight w1*rank(G1)+(w2-w1)*rank(G2)+(w3-w2)*rank(G3). Exhausting the finite e1,e2,e3 relaxation yields the recorded residual-union penalty.
